import time

@dataclass
class Record:
    source: str
    data: dict[str, Any]
    timestamp: float = 0.0

        tags = raw.pop("_tags", [])
        metadata = raw.pop("_meta", {})

            "tags": self.tags,
            "metadata": self.metadata,

        merged_data = {**self.data, **other.data}
